title: 68th OPEC+ Joint Ministerial Monitoring Committee (JMMC)
source: EST: opec.org press release 2026-08-02 (67th JMMC) states verbatim 'The next meeting of the JMMC (68th) is scheduled for 4 October 2026' — primary-sourced but filed estimate per the event-research lane's no-self-confirm limit, checked 2026-08-31. Re-tiered 2026-09-20 per FT-27 (docs/research/forward-tests/legacy.md), scored PASS 2026-09-08 by the opec-plus-meeting-2026-09-06 close-out against opec.org/pr-detail/1835613-6-september-2026.html, re-verified direct by this pulse 2026-09-20: 'The next meeting will be held on 4 October 2026.'
notes: The successor checkpoint to opec-plus-meeting-2026-09-06, originally filed `low`: the JMMC monitors DoC conformity and compensation and RECOMMENDS — it does not set quotas, which is the seven-country group's job. Re-tiered `low` -> `medium` 2026-09-20: 2026-10-04 is now confirmed a two-body day (FT-27 PASS) and the group's own quota decision is tracked separately as the canonical sibling event `opec-plus-meeting-2026-10-04` (medium) — this JMMC entry stays `medium` rather than `low` because the same day carries the first public OPEC+ forum after the 2027 Maximum-Sustainable-Capacity baseline audits (Jan-Sep 2026) close, and because Iraq is on record using the UAE's 2026-05-01 exit as leverage for a higher baseline (Semafor, 2026-09-03) while Kazakhstan carries the alliance's largest cumulative compensation burden. Discovered during the opec-plus-meeting-2026-09-06 initial research (2026-08-31).
